Pizza King Menu – A Complete Guide to the Best Pizza Choices

Welcome to the most informational and complete guide to the Pizza King menu, created for pizza lovers who want to explore every flavorful option available. Whether you’re searching for your next favorite pizza, curious about the latest menu additions, or interested in learning about the variety of sub, salad, beverage, and dessert options, this long-form guide will serve all your needs. We’ve gone deep into the offerings at Pizza King to help you make informed choices, including price tables, reviews, and more.

Pizza – A Look Into the Heart of the Pizza King Menu

At the core of the menu for Pizza King is, of course, pizza. With a legacy that extends since the brand’s founding, Pizza King offers a rich and flavorful selection that combines classic and creative recipes.

Specialty Pizza Options

The specialty pizzas at Pizza King are some of the most favorite choices by customers. Every pie is baked in a traditional oven, topped with fresh ingredients, and served with love. These signature pizzas feature premium toppings and robust flavors.

Specialty Pizza Toppings Price (Medium) Price (Large)
King’s Supreme Pepperoni, sausage, mushroom, green peppers, onion, black olives $13.99 $17.99
BBQ Chicken Delight Chicken, red onions, bbq sauce, mozzarella, cheddar cheese $12.99 $16.99
Veggie Lovers Tomato, mushroom, green peppers, onion, green olives, black olives $11.99 $15.99
Meat Feast Beef, bacon, sausage, pepperoni, ham $13.49 $17.49
Hawaiian Island Ham, pineapple, extra cheese $11.49 $15.49

Salad – Fresh and Crisp Side Offerings

Every great pizza needs a refreshing salad on the side. Pizza King prepares their salads with lettuce, ripe tomato, onion, and your choice of dressing such as ranch or Italian.

Salad Options and Prices

Salad Ingredients Price
Garden Salad Lettuce, tomato, cucumber, onion, green pepper $4.99
Chef Salad Lettuce, ham, turkey, egg, cheese, tomato, ranch $6.99
Greek Salad Lettuce, feta cheese, black olives, tomato, oil $6.49
Chicken Caesar Romaine lettuce, grilled chicken, Parmesan, Caesar dressing $6.99

Sandwich – Oven-Toasted Goodness

Sandwich selections at Pizza King feature a fusion of American and Italian flavors, made with crispy bread and oven-roasted meats.

Popular Sandwiches

  • Italian Sub: Salami, ham, mozzarella, lettuce, tomato, mayo

  • Buffalo Chicken Sandwich: Spicy chicken, ranch, cheddar cheese

  • Gyros Sandwich: Gyro meat, tomato, onion, tzatziki

Prices range from $5.99 to $7.99.

Specialty – Unique Pizza Creations

Pizza King often launches specialty items that rotate seasonally. These feature experimental toppings like banana peppers, sauerkraut, or jalapeno to give your taste buds a ride.

Special Ingredients Price
German Style Sausage, sauerkraut, onion, mozzarella $12.99
Spicy Buffalo Pizza Chicken, buffalo sauce, red onion, cheddar cheese $13.49

Beverage – Quench Your Thirst

Pair your meal with a beverage from the menu. Options include classic sodas, Italian sparkling drinks, and signature lemonade.

Drink Size Price
Soft Drink 16 oz $1.99
Bottled Water 500ml $1.49
Italian Soda 12 oz $2.49
Lemonade 16 oz $2.29

Side – Add-Ons for the Perfect Meal

The side options at Pizza King complement any main dish. Choose from breadsticks, garlic knots, or mozzarella sticks.

Side Quantity Price
Garlic Knots 6 pieces $3.99
Breadsticks 6 pieces $3.49
Mozzarella Sticks 5 sticks $4.49

Delivery – Convenience at Your Door

Pizza King offers delivery within a 5–10-mile radius. You can order by phone, app, or their website. Delivery time ranges between 30–45 minutes.

Wing – Perfectly Fried and Sauced

Wings are a favorite on the Pizza King menu, offered in traditional and boneless forms. Sauce choices include bbq, buffalo, garlic Parmesan, and lemon pepper.

Wing Flavor 6 Pc 12 Pc
BBQ $6.49 $11.99
Buffalo $6.49 $11.99
Garlic Parmesan $6.99 $12.49

Load More Content – Explore Additional Options

Still hungry? Pizza King lets you build your own pizza, sub, or pasta meal with endless customizations.

Build Your Own Pizza

Crust Type Options
Classic Thin, Hand-Tossed, Deep Dish
Premium Garlic-Parmesan, Stuffed Crust
Toppings Ingredients
Meats Pepperoni, sausage, ham, bacon
Veggies Onion, tomato, green peppers, olives

Pasta – Hearty Italian Classics

The pasta dishes are baked in the oven and topped with melted mozzarella. You can also add meatballs or italian sausage for extra flavor.

Pasta Dish Description Price
Spaghetti With marinara and Parmesan $7.99
Baked Ziti Ricotta, mozzarella, tomato sauce $8.49
Alfredo Creamy white sauce, chicken, green peppers $8.99

Dessert – The Sweet Finish

Top off your meal with a decadent dessert. Whether you crave chocolate or cinnamon, there’s something for every sweet tooth.

Dessert Description Price
Chocolate Brownie Warm, gooey, and topped with syrup $3.99
Cinnamon Breadsticks Served with vanilla icing $3.49
Cheesecake Slice Creamy New York-style $4.29

Build – Your Own Sub, Pizza, or Pasta

From sub combinations to pizza masterpieces, you can mix and match every ingredient to fit your cravings.

Build Option Choices Available
Sub Ham, salami, mozzarella, lettuce, mayo
Pizza Up to 4 toppings, 3 crust styles
Pasta Choice of sauce, protein, cheese

Topping – Full Range of Pizza Toppings

Pizza King uses high-quality ingredient choices for topping selections.

Topping Type Options
Meats Pepperoni, bacon, beef, salami, ham
Vegetables Mushroom, green peppers, onion, tomato
Cheeses Mozzarella, cheddar cheese, feta cheese

Bread – Crust and Sides Worth Craving

Bread makes the base of every dish. Pizza King offers garlic butter crusts, Parmesan dusted breadsticks, and cheesy options.

Garlic – An Essential Flavor

Garlic is used in sauces, breads, and marinades. The restaurant infuses garlic into crusts and garlic knots to intensify flavor.

Review – Customer Feedback on Pizza King

Most review sources praise Pizza King for having one of the best pizza selections around, with many noting its fast service and consistent quality.

Signature – Iconic Dishes That Made Pizza King Famous

Some dishes are signature to Pizza King and have remained unchanged since its founding. These include:

  • The King’s Supreme

  • Buffalo Chicken Pizza

  • Oven-baked Italian Subs

Appetizer – Start Your Meal Right

Choose an appetizer before your main course. Options include garlic knots, jalapeno poppers, and cheese bites.

Appetizer Price
Jalapeno Poppers $4.99
Cheese Bites $4.49 
Want to explore more flavorful beverages and snack options? Check out the full Philz Coffee menu featuring artisan blends, food pairings, pricing info, and delivery options.

Final Thoughts

Pizza King is not just a pizza place — it’s a restaurant that brings people together around delicious food. From its legendary menu items to its high-quality ingredients, Pizza King continues to deliver satisfaction every time. Whether you’re customizing a personal pizza or enjoying a combination sub, there’s something for everyone.
